Counted by re-reading each artifact rather than by trusting a prior report, and the count spans two error conventions: cycle 1 filed those refusals under `http_4xx` because the closed error set had no member for a refusal until harness-v3 added one. Two of the 6 are pre-flights that record bodies rather than observations, and one of those names them by agency code. This is the persistence behind the report's accessibility finding: not a transient, and not a sampling accident. Task cc_tasks/2026-09-09_report_draft.md §2. (cc_tasks/2026-09-09_report_draft.md)
